summary: Export containerized secrets with `podman secret inspect --showsecret --format "{{.SecretData}}"` for `controller_secret_key`, `hub_secret_key`, `hub_database_fields` (becomes `hub_db_fields_encryption_key`) and `gateway_secret_key`; copy any `extra_settings` from the inventory into a file under `controller/custom_configs`.
questions: How do I get the controller secret key from containerized AAP?
podman secret inspect for AAP migration
How do I export extra_settings for migration?

answer_card.title: Collect containerized secrets
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
podman secret inspect --showsecret --format "{{.SecretData}}" controller_secret_key
podman secret inspect --showsecret --format "{{.SecretData}}" hub_secret_key
podman secret inspect --showsecret --format "{{.SecretData}}" hub_database_fields   # hub_db_fields_encryption_key
podman secret inspect --showsecret --format "{{.SecretData}}" gateway_secret_key
```
Put each into `secrets.yml`; save inventory `extra_settings` under `controller/custom_configs/`.
